{{Quote|With the Bothan's customary impeccable timing.|[[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]]|<ref name="DP" />}}
A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] served as the '''vice chancellor''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] under [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as part of the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]. In the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]], during a session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] involving a discussion about creating a [[Republic Military/Legends|military]], outrage filled the Rotunda, and the Bothan unnecessarily called for quiet. After Valorum asked the Senate to provide private militaries for a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the planet [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]], the vice chancellor was forced to try to establish order. Shortly after, the Bothan gave the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] senator, [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], permission to speak. [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], who served as one of the [[Aide/Legends|aides]] of Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], commented that the Bothan did so with customary impeccable timing.<ref name="DP" />
